title: SparsePIMISampler — copy-node sparsification on iCE40 (FINAL PIMI attempt)
retirement_reason: Three structural strategies + parallel update strategy all failed to reach 5x sweep reduction on the N=8 ring+chord ferromagnetic graph. Root finding: ring+chord graph has degree=3 already; sparse k=3,4,5 == dense for this graph. The 15-25x speedup in arXiv 2604.17109 requires harder, larger, denser constraint problems. iCE40 PIMI retired to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml.
notes: SparsePIMISampler with k=3,4,5 produces identical results to SynchronousPIMISampler (Exp 889) because the N=8 ring+chord graph has max degree=3 — every spin already connects to exactly 3 neighbors (2 ring + 1 chord). With k>=3, _sparsify keeps all existing couplings and J_sparse==J_dense. Sweeps reduction = 4.33x (dense_baseline 12.99 / sparse_sweeps 3), below the 5x target. Synthesis: 126 SB_LUT4 on iCE40 HX8K (identical to v3 since topology is the same). The sparse adjacency hypothesis (arXiv 2503.01177) is not refuted — it requires a problem with spurious long-range weak couplings, which the ring+chord graph does not have. PIMI retirement is confirmed: all four structural and update-strategy hypotheses tested, none reached 5x.
